entries.proposition: WWOX IS ONE OF ELEVEN GENES WITH THE HIGHEST OCCURRENCE OF DAMAGING VARIANTS AMONG THE 104 HDL CANDIDATE GENES, AT n = 4. This is an occurrence count inside a candidate-gene list, not an association.
entries.snippet: The 11 HDL genes with the highest occurrence of damaging variants were ABCA1 (n = 20), STAB1 (n = 9), OSBPL1A (n = 8), CPS1 (n = 8), CD36 (n = 7), LRP1 (n = 6), and ABCA8 (n = 6), GOT2 (n = 5), AMPD3 (n = 5), WWOX (n = 4), and IRS1 (n = 4)

entries.proposition: THE GENOME-WIDE SIGNIFICANT BURDEN IS IN FOUR GENES AND WWOX IS NOT ONE OF THEM. The WWOX n = 4 is therefore explicitly not an association in this paper.
entries.snippet: Binomial analysis for rare (MAF ≤ 0.001) heterozygous D-Mis or LoF variants identified the ABCA1, LDLR, HK3, and CFTR genes with genome-wide statistical significance
entries.anchor: Results, Binomial and PANTHER analysis results, first sentence

experimental_context.genotype: rare damaging missense or loss-of-function, MAF <= 0.001
experimental_context.comparator: de novo mutability expectation adjusted by this cohort's base-pair coverage, with control data sets where coverage was reliable

entries.proposition: THE COHORT HAS NO NORMAL-HDL-C COMPARATOR AT ALL, BY THE AUTHORS' OWN STATEMENT. Nothing in this paper licenses a statement that WWOX heterozygotes are enriched among people with low HDL-C.
entries.snippet: we were not able to compare the prevalence of mutations among a cohort considered to have normal levels
entries.anchor: Discussion, final paragraph, limitation of the candidate-gene approach

entries.proposition: NO COPY-NUMBER EVENT WAS FOUND IN ANY OF THE 104 HDL CANDIDATE GENES, SO THERE IS NO WWOX DELETION OR DUPLICATION IN THIS COHORT. An earned null on the structural-variant axis, within the stated sensitivity limit.
entries.snippet: No CNVs were found among our list of 104 HDL candidate genes
entries.anchor: Results, Copy number variants, final sentences

entries.proposition: THE FOUR WWOX OCCURRENCES ARE THREE DISTINCT HETEROZYGOUS MISSENSE ALLELES, AND THE ONE CARRIED BY TWO PARTICIPANTS IS ANNOTATED BENIGN IN ClinVar AND IS COMMON AT gnomAD 7.5e-03. No loss-of-function, no frameshift, no splice allele, no homozygote.

entries.proposition: PANEL READING, Figure 1. The histogram title states '144 occurrences in 101 patients', against the text's 110 participants (and 120 variants); the text's own per-person tallies imply about 151 to 161 occurrences, so neither is reconciled. The WWOX bar reads 4 and is entirely the missense colour, with no frameshift, splice or stop-gained segment, in agreement with the text's n = 4 and with three distinct missense alleles in the supplement. The mismatch is in the cohort totals, not in the WWOX count.

entries.proposition: PANEL READING, Figure 3. Quantile-quantile plots for the damaging-variant binomial test: the gene tables beside them list ABCA1 and LDLR at MAF <= 0.0001 and ABCA1, LDLR, HK3 and CFTR at MAF <= 0.001 as the significant (green) rows, then the next rows to DYSF, KIF17 and others; WWOX appears in neither table and its own p value is printed nowhere. A figure-only reader cannot recover a WWOX statistic.

entries.proposition: THE CLINVAR DISEASE COLUMN FOR THE BENIGN ALLELE LISTS WWOX-RELATED CONDITION NAMES. The p.Arg120Trp row carries significance 'other|Benign|Benign' and, in the disease column, 'not specified|Epileptic encephalopathy, early infantile, 1|Spinocerebellar ataxia, autosomal recessive 12'. That column names the conditions ClinVar associates with the gene's records for the entry; the classification beside it is Benign, so the row is not an assertion of pathogenicity.
